issue_title: A Rage in Arkham, Part One
description:
A Rage is Arkham Part 1 Spinning out of the Bloodline crossover event, Tommy Monaghan is the only hitman in Gotham City to take on super-powered contracts. Using his x-ray vision and telepathy, Tommy has an upper-hand on the criminal element he removes for a cost. However a new million dollar contract puts Tommy within the sights of another Gotham City vigilante. Thus begins one of the greatest comic runs mixing sincerity, violence, paranormal entities, and lots and lots of bullets from some of the most crazed creators in the medium.

Issue one of the acclaimed series from Garth Ennis and John McCrea.

Tommy Monaghan is a hitman specialising in the elimination of superheroes.

A couple of demons from Hell want to recruit him. And they send one of their lieutenants to do the job.

Also, someone wants him to kill...The Joker?! Yes. Joker.

Tommy attempts to escape from the Gotham City Police with a hostage in tow, but just when things seem to go his way, Mr. Truman and Feekle enlist some help to bring him in: Green Lantern Kyle Rayner! "Local Heroes" Part 2!

A police goon squad gather to take Tommy down. Dirty, rotten cops but nothing to kill them over. How can Tommy make it past a dozen well armed officers when he can't even fire a single bullet?

A DC ONE MILLION tie-in! Four teenagers in the far-flung future of the 853rd Century decide to use their father's time-displacement unit to finally fulfill a life-long dream: to meet their favorite legendary super-hero from the past. Tommy Monaghan pays a visit to the 853rd Century!

In the far future iconic items grant common citizens super-powers. The goggles that belong to the explosive hero Gunfire is seen granting the same to another citizen. Naive young men, thinking they can gain power, kidnap Tommy from his bar-seat at Noonan's. Tommy forces them to send him back. Then men then take Etrigan the Demon next; the hell-spawned creature kills them all.
Dark, nasty government forces conspire to hire Tommy. And they've convinced Green Lantern to help them out. How can Tommy sweet-talk a space-cop who can do nearly anything?

The final chapter of "Local Heroes" by Eisner Award-winner Garth Ennis! Tommy confronts Mr. Truman and Feekle, but how will he solve this situation--and what will Green Lantern Kyle Rayner say about his choices?

It's a telepathic Irishman, a naive space-cop and a disgraced Gotham police detective against the worst bastards the CIA has to offer. Pity the government goons.

issue_title: Zombie Night at the Gotham Aquarium Part One of Two
description: Tommy takes an a contract to track down and take out a scientist who can create zombies. Unfortunately the man is one step ahead of them and the Gotham Aquarium is over-taken. And the animals are escaping their cages...

issue_title: Zombie Night at the Gotham Aquarium, Part Two
description:
Zombie humans are one thing, but Tommy Monaghan comes face-to-face with zombie seals, sharks and octopodes! Terrors from the deep arise in "Zombie Night at the Gotham Aquarium" Part 2!

The Gotham Aquarium is now full of bloodthirsty zombie animals. It's time to leave but the place is falling apart...and so is the team.

"Ace of Killers" Part 1! A demonic enemy comes knocking for Tommy Monaghan's soul: Hell's personal hitman, the Mawzir! But how does Catwoman fit into the creature's sudden appearance?

The Mawzir is back to kill Tommy Monaghan, anyone who is with him, nearby police officers...plus he has an army of Mafia mooks to back him up.

After employing the "Cat Signal," things heat up for Tommy Monaghan when Catwoman arrives on the scene. And when it comes to hunting demons, you have to call in an expert: Jason Blood! "Ace of Killers" continues with Part 2.

The Mawzir is after Tommy and his friends. Their only hope is a special gun...which is lost in the depths of Hell!

Tommy, Tiegel, Catwoman and others are trapped in a church under attack by a Mafia goon squad. The Mawzir, who can't actually shoot at consecrated ground, is off slaughtering responding cops. The only hope for anyone inside is Etrigan, deep in the depths of hell, to fetch the Ace of Winchesters, a gun that could kill any demon. But first, Etrigan has to conquer hell itself!

While Etrigan and Baytor battle the Arkannone for the Ace of Winchesters, Tommy, Catwoman, Natt and Tiegel are at the mercy of the Mawzir. But help arrives in the form of...Section Eight? "Ace of Killers," part 4.

Six-Pac tries to rescue his friends by gathering the 'old band', a group of somewhat super-powered lunatics.

Tommy and his friends are making a stand inside a church, with the Mawzir, a demon, eager for their deaths. And the only thing keeping this six-armed gun-demon from joining is that the building is still standing and thus concescrated.

And then the building explodes.

issue_title: A Rage in Arkham, Part Two
description:
A Rage is Arkham Part 2 After last issue's finale, Tommy has to think quickly to escape arrest. Meanwhile the Mawzir begins to track Tommy for recruitment as an agent of the Lords of the Gun. With word out that Tommy has accepted the hit on the Joker, Tommy picks up a list of additional Arkham inmates with hits on their head. Even with Batman watching, Tommy manages to make his way into Arkham, but everything does not turn out as planned.

Tommy has had near-free run of Arkham Asylum, shooting dead many horrible people in order to fill many contracts. But his attempt to do the world a favor by plugging the Joker goes horribly, horribly wrong.

The conclusion to "Ace of Killers!" Out of options and out of ammo, Tommy faces down the Mawzir in a battle for his very soul. But when all seems lost, someone with a few lives to spare might be able to help...

After the high-octane events of the previous arc, Tommy Monaghan finally gets a bit of rest from the super-powered and supernatural--which leaves room for his personal life to go a little crazy when he and Tiegel officially start a relationship!

Tommy's attempt to relax and have a happy day leaves him landing literally in the middle of a deal. He tries to calm the situation but it goes badly and bullets fly and the wrong, wrong people die.The effects of this issue will last through the rest of the series.

It's a holiday-themed HITMAN Christmas special! Everything seems quiet on Christmas Eve, but all heck breaks loose when a radioactive Santa goes on a rampage through the street of Gotham!

Tommy and Natt have no money for Christmas presents this year.

That is until they get a contract to take out a crazed super-villain dressed as Santa Claus.

Notes:

  • Ranked #93 in Wizard Magazine's list of "100 Best Single Issue Comics Since You Were Born".

A new story arc begins with "Who Dares Wins" Part 1. The past comes back to haunt Tommy Monaghan and Natt after a group of S.A.S soldiers are sent to kill the duo as revenge for a "friendly fire" incident during Desert Storm.

A long time ago, a horrible mistake happened in the Iraqi desert. Now the consequences have come home for Tommy and Nat, in the form of British SAS assassins.

British SAS soldiers, some of the best-trained men in all the world, come looking for Tommy and Natt. During the latter's Middle East military service, a horrible accident had occured and they tried to sweep it under the rug. Now it's time to pay the price.

After the blood-filled events of last issue, the S.A.S. go after Tommy through his friends and kidnap Sean Noonan. Can Tommy calm down enough to save his friend...or will yet another buddy's blood leave a stain on his conscience? "Who Dares Wins" Part 3.

A British SAS hit-squad, trying to gain revenge for old friends lost, are having quite a bad-go of it themselves. And the Gotham Mafia is getting angry at things themselves but between Tommy and the best England has to offer, they are just a distraction.

Tommy and Natt fought back against the S.A.S. soldiers, but only succeeded in pushing their enemies even further. They must find a way to even the odds before it not only costs them their lives, but Sean's as well! "Who Dares Wins" Part 4.

Gotham's mafia is picked apart as what was once a 'simple' hit against Tommy and Natt the Hat degenerates into even more death and despair.

In the conclusion to Garth Ennis' latest HITMAN arc, dissention among the ranks of the S.A.S. might give Tommy and Natt the opportunity they need as violence explodes in a vicious final showdown between the duo, the S.A.S. and Men's Room Louie's mob!
The events of the last arc have left Tommy Monaghan experiencing nightmares, night after night. The Hitman has a major crisis of conscience and faith in this aftermath issue to "Who Dare Wins!"

"Tommy's Heroes" Part 1! With the Gotham mobs pinning the massacre at Men Room's Louie's place on Tommy and Natt, the pair join with Ringo and Hacken for a million dollar offer: enlist as mercenaries for six months' work in Central Africa!

issue_title: A Rage in Arkham, Part Three
description:
All hell breaks loose as Hitman realizes too late that his assignment to execute the Joker was a setup: the Mawzir, a gun-wielding demon, is closing in to recruit Tommy Monaghan as an assassin for the Arkanonne, two bullet-ridden demonlords. Meanwhile, Batman is on Hitman's tail as well...and the Dark Knight may be an even bigger problem for Monaghan than going to hell.

Tommy, Batman and a six armed murder-demon are tearing through the basements of Arkham Asylum. Innocent lives are in danger and even the Joker takes a bullet!

Tommy's Central African adventure continues as the crew heads into a village to destroy the rebel food supply. But when Scarlet Rose and Skull begin to murder innocent bystanders, it brings them into direct conflict with Monaghan. "Tommy's Heroes" Part 2.

After turning against the violent acts of their unit, Tommy and Mitchell struggle to make their way across the desert, all while trying to stay ahead of the mercenaries sent to eliminate them! "Tommy's Heroes"Part 3.

Tommy has been scammed by those looking to recruit mercenaries. He thought he was going to assist in saving innocent lives deep in the African desert. But he's stuck with a horrible group of psychopaths fighting...other bastards. It's a real moral dilemma...and then things get much, much worse.

Tommy and the boys meet up with Ributu, the Tynandan rebel leader--but will Tommy use the opportunity to find a way out or will he end up joining the cause? Find out in "Tommy's Heroes" Part 4 of 5.

Good intentions go bad; Tommy and his friends had signed up to help out refugees in a small African country. However, they had been scammed and the goodwill organization is corrupt as the government they are fighting. So Tommy and his friends and a WW2 tank they find...well, somebody's gotta make things right.

The explosive finale of "Tommy's Heroes!" Tommy and his crew bring out the big guns and take the fight directly to Kijaro! But with Scarlet Rose and Skull standing in the way, even the big guns might not be big enough!

Tommy's attempt to do some good has gone completely to hell. He's now stuck deep in the middle of an African country, it's rulers a team of slaughter-happy psychopaths. But what are Tommy and his friends going to have to do to make things right? Are they even any better then those they are fighting?

Of Thee I Sing Superman and Tommy discuss the nature of hope and salvation, after Superman is tested by the expectations of a man he is unable to save. A truly fantastic issue, that outlines the differences of Superman and Tommy through their unique moralistic worldviews and their actions as discrete heroes of the DC universe.

Superman, mistaking Tommy for a casual fan, gets to talking. Superman is suffering a deep depression, he had failed and seen an innocent man die in front of him.

Notes:

  • Ranked #46 in Wizard Magazine's list of "100 Best Single Issue Comics Since You Were Born".

A romantic interlude for Tommy is cut short by the unexpected arrival of Frances Monaghan, the older sister Tommy never knew he had, who brings a dramatic revelation about how Tommy came to be abandoned as an infant!

The dark secrets of Tommy's life finally reveal themselves. Tommy must take a trip for mad killers are on the loose and innocent lives are in danger.

The secret that Sean has kept from Tommy all these years slowly comes to light. Tommy and his newly discovered sister, Frances, trace their mother's horrific final days, days culminating in her death at the hands of Tommy's own father.

Tommy's bastard of a father continues his murderous ways in order to cover past sins. Tommy decides the old man has earned a bullet.

While Tommy hadn't been paying attention, Gotham had gone completely to hell. Various disasters led to the United States government to abandon the city and close it off. This leads to various powers trying to take the city for themselves. Vampires decide to go for 'The Cauldron', Tommy's streets.

With the government having long ago left Gotham City, vampires decide to try to move in, to make it their private feeding ground. Tommy doesn't like this at all so in order to fight them he recruits, well, everyone.

issue_title: For Tomorrow, Part One of Four
description:
Unimaginable secrets of rival assassin Ringo Chen are revealed in "For Tomorrow" part 1! One of the first to come to light is that Ringo just happens to be dating Wendy, Tommy's girlfriend from the first year of the series. And the tension and danger only intensify from there!

Simply because they are so skilled with guns, tensions rise between Tommy and his friend Ringo Chen.

It's never a good idea to get on a mob boss's bad side, particularly when the mob boss is Moe Dubelez, and the bad side is his deceased ""Siamese"" twin, Joe. Joe was offed a while back by Hitman, and has spent the time since busily decomposing and raising a stench only heaven could cure. Seeking vengeance, brother Moe hires his own hitman to kill Tommy Monaghan--a cold-blooded pro named Johnny Navarone.

It's flashback time as someone close to Tommy is destined to die. And his dear friend Natt the Hat has just shown up. So has a bunch of ninja killers.

issue_title: For Tomorrow, Part Two of Four
description:
The tension between Tommy and Ringo escalates, becoming apparent even to the crew at Noonan's. Tommy pays a visit to Wendy to try and defuse the situation--but trouble breaks when Ringo shows up and sees them together! "For Tomorrow" part 2.

Tommy is caught up in a revenge hit on one of his friends, Ringo Chen.

issue_title: For Tomorrow, Part Three of Four
description:
The torture continues for Tommy and Ringo as the Waterman puts the duo through the most horrendous moments of their lives! Plus, even more secrets are revealed about Ringo's past in China and how he made his way to America. "For Tomorrow" part 3.

In between being tortured by Waterman for the benefit of a client, Tommy learns of Ringo's past life, including time spent in the Chinese military.

issue_title: For Tomorrow, Part Four of Four
description:
In "For Tomorrow" part 4, Tommy and Ringo make their final stand against the electric freak known as the Waterman...and at least one participant is not walking away!

Tommy takes down everyone responsible for Ringo's death.

issue_title: The Morning After, The Night Before
description:
After the events of the last arc, Tommy goes to Wendy's and falls into some old habits and makes a decision that he will definitely regret--especially when Teigel finds out about it!

Tommy tries to get his life back together; he and Natt take on the job of killing a pedophile.

"Fresh Meat" part 1! What do you get when you put Tommy and Natt on an experimental time machine at the Injun Peak Research Center--the same place responsible for the zombie creatures in "Local Heroes"--and send them back to the Cretaceous Period? Find out here!

A simple quest for the bathroom leads Tommy and Natt into the era of the dinosaurs. Their companions are an idiotic rich man and a squad of brutal killers who know Tommy well. Things go south quick and Tommy and Natt ride the timestream home. They are unaware that following them is a flesh-hungry dinosaur.

When a Tyrannosaur pack discovers a time-tunnel to 20th century Gotham City, things rapidly go awry. Tommy and Natt take to the skies as weird science gets weirder, and lots of people get chewed up! "Fresh Meat" part 2.

Dinosaurs are munching on innocent Gotham citizens. Tommy and Natt want to get in and help but this is 'No Man's Land' with the entire Gotham island cut off from society. Transportation has to be improvised.

In "Fresh Meat" part 3, Scarback, the Tyrannosaur King, leads his pack on an unstoppable rampage deep into the Cauldron. With Tommy and Natt dogfighting Pterodactyls and the vengeance-crazed Jake Butcher on the loose, can anyone stop the monsters out of time in time?

Dinosaurs rampaging through Gotham City. Horrifying, yes, but it's much much worse because 'No Man's Land' has cut the city off from most of it's protectors. Hitman and Natt the Hat step up to fight the creatures. In the end, the annoyance of random gunfire, the air pollution and the running humans just outright tasting bad has the dinos decide to head back through the time portal to their own land.

"The Old Dog" part 1! Sean Noonan, Tommy's oldest friend, reveals the secrets of a lifetime's killing, starting with the heroic naval battle he witnessed in World War II. Meanwhile, Tommy's own past starts to catch up with him again as the daughter of an old enemy plots a bloody vendetta.

The unbelievably evil Isabella Peretti sends her murderous uncle Benito after Tommy, determined to settle the score for Men's Room Louie once and for all. As Tiegel struggles to save the wounded Tommy, the crew assembles at Noonan's for one final, bloody battle. "The Old Dog" part 2.

The bloody showdown at Noonan's Bar reaches its epic conclusion! Can Tommy and his little band hold out against the overwhelming forces of the mob? And will the vicious Benito Gallo fall into Sean's trap? Several characters meet their destiny as the battle is fought to the finish. "The Old Dog" part 3.

A new vigilante is prowling the streets of Gotham City. He's Nightfist, and he's a man with a price on his head that Hitman means to collect. But Nightfist isn't exactly the hero he pretends to be, and while Tommy Monaghan goes on the hunt for him, the infamous Johnny Navarone is closing in to win the bounty for executing Hitman.

Gotham City's newest urban vigilante is just a degenerate drug dealer.

In this epilogue to "The Old Dog," we peer into HITMAN's future. Sixty years from now, a mysterious stranger in Noonan's Bar shares a bloody, legendary tale of Tommy Monaghan and his friends.

In a story set some time in the future, a mysterious strange sets the story straight for several naive college students. Including the horrible things Tommy had down to revenge himself for Sean Noonan's death.

"Superguy" part 1 reveals the origin of Six-Pack and the slightly deranged super-team known as Section Eight. A menace from beyond the furthest dimensions of Hell threatens the world...and only the drunks and crazies can save the day!

When the Demon gods of line and science threatens Gotham and the day needs saving it's up to... a team full of drunks and crazy people?

In "Superguy" part 2, the Many-Angled Ones have only one desire: an Earth of screaming dead with a billion souls to swallow, a planet wreathed in torment, ringed by despair. Six-Pack and Section Eight take on the bad guys in a senses-shattering climax!

Most of Six-Pack's super-team is slain in battle against the demonic Many Angled Ones. Six-Pack sacrifices his freedom in order to get the monsters to retreat to their own dimension. A statue is built in his honor.

"Closing Time" part 1, a.k.a. the beginning of the end! When Tommy Monaghan tries to help an old friend, he winds up facing the deadliest adversary of his career. Characters old and new join together for the fight of Tommy Monaghan's life!

Tommy's close friend, a waitress, sees her boss murdered and barely escapes alive from a CIA hit-team. She runs to Tommy for protection, which causes it's own trouble as the CIA wants him dead as well.

The ultimate killer prepares to face Tommy Monaghan. And, sadly, Tommy's best chance at survival lies with the CIA agent who once sent Green Lantern into the Cauldron to capture our hero. "Closing Time" part 2.

One of Tommy Monaghan's friends is the target of the CIA, for she has witnessed a bestial man that escaped from their project. Tommy puts her under his protection. Other enemies gather and an old adversary defects to his side.

Old enemies combine to turn the Cauldron into the most dangerous place on Earth for Tommy, as the full horror of Agent Truman's experiments come to light. "Closing Time" part 3.

Tommy's holed up with his last few allies as they try to protect a dear friend from a government hit squad. His on-again, off-again girlfriend Tiegel has a nasty argument with him and splits for the last time.

The origin of Tommy Monaghan! A special issue focusing on the early years of everyone's favorite Hitman, as we see his early friendship with Pat and the years he was raised by Sean. This leads to the fateful night of horror that brought him down the path to being a hired killer. "Closing Time" part 4.

Tommy's war against a super-hero-obsessed CIA man continues. His goal; protect a dear friend from assassination.

The origin tale of Tommy Monaghan continues! This issue flashes back to Tommy's days as a United States Marine and when he first hooked up with Natt! "Closing Time" part 5.

A flashback to Tommy's army days, where a simple plan to bust up a scam turns quite horrible.

Marc Navarone, the son of the late Johnny Navarone, prepares for his final confrontation with Tommy! Plus, Natt and McAllister learn the meaning of trust, as they do their best to locate Tommy and add firepower to his side. "Closing Time" part 6.

A last-ditch plan of Noonan's to protect Tommy from beyond the grave could instead end in horrible death and destruction. His only hope, a woman he's not quite sure he can trust.

Deep within the bowels of the underground center that houses Truman's Bloodlines project, Tommy, Natt and McAllister go up against CIA guards bent on protecting the secrecy of the horrific experiments at all costs.

Between flying bullets and deadly ambushes, Johnny Navarone is making Hitman's life hell! Only Natt the Hat can save Tommy Monaghan's hash, but there only one place close enough to get Hitman the medical attention he needs--the home of Wendy, Tommy's girlfriend!

Tommy is shot full of holes in an attempt to take down the scum that killed his friend. But in saving his life, his friends may yet drive away another loved one.

Be there for the end in "Closing Time" part 8! The extra-sized finale has Tommy and Natt facing off against Truman and his men. Bullets fly, people die, and last call rings out for HITMAN!

The final storyline issue of Garth Ennis' Hitman.

Tommy and Natt try their best to escort their innocent pregnant friend to safety. It doesn't exactly work well. An FBI ally does take the woman to a safehouse but Tommy and Natt end up shot to pieces on a Gotham empty lot. Mr. Truman falls dead in the crossfire. As the two heroes lay dying they both experience a vision of Noonan's bar where all the beer is free, guns are not allowed and all their deceased friends are waiting.

In revenge for their murdered friend, Tommy and Natt go the Siamese twin crimelord's house with the plan of simply killing every single person there. It goes well into Johnny Navarone shows up and again badly wounds Tommy. A lucky shot destroys Johnny's hand. Stunned, he doesn't react as Tommy shoots him dead.

"The Final Night" tie-in issue! As the sun extinguishes and the end draws near, Tommy, Sean, Natt, Hacken and Ringo all gather in Noonan's Bar for one last drink. They share personal stories from their past during what seems to be their final moments.

With the sun having vanished, Tommy and his friends hole in Noonan's bar and share tales of near-death incidents. Sort of.

The gritty series by award-winning writer Garth Ennis continues in the new arc "Local Heroes!" In part 1, Tommy buries his friend, but his mourning gets cut short when men from the U.S. government show up with evidence linking him to the Dubelz mansion massacre!

Tommy attends the funeral of his closest child-hood friend while new forces gather against him.

In this first DC COMICS - THE NEW 52 collection of THE FLASH, Mob Rule wages a campaign of crime across Central City, plunging the city into darkness! The only way The Flash can save his city is to make his brain function even faster than before - but as much as it helps him, it also comes at a steep price.

Collects issues #1-8 of the original monthly series.

The Rogues Gallery is united for the first time in The New 52 in this title collecting issues #0, 9-12 and THE FLASH ANNUAL #1! Who is behind their sudden organization, and why are they after their Captain Cold?

When Grodd and his gorilla army descend on Central City, The Flash will have to contend with a threat unlike any he's faced before: murderous, ruthless and without principle. With mammoth strength and mind-control powers, Grodd will not stop until he conquers the city with its heroes blood on his hands. Knowing he cannot defeat this new foe alone, The Flash will need the help of his former enemies, the Rogues, if he wants to keep himself and Central City alive. This new hardcover collects THE FLASH #13-19.

In this new hardcover, a mysterious and powerful Speed-Force killer has left a trail of bodies in his wake, and only Barry has the power to stop him. But when the killer stays one step ahead of him, Barry finds himself face to face with the Teen Titans and Kid Flash for the first time, which leads to a confrontation with the Reverse Flash! Don't miss these stories from THE FLASH #20-25, and #23.2: REVERSE FLASH!
In these stories from issues #26-29 and FLASH ANNUAL #2, find out how Barry Allen adjusts after his battle with Reverse-Flash! Plus, witness the first meeting of The Flash and Green Lantern!

In these tales from THE FLASH #30-35, THE FLASH ANNUAL #3 and THE FLASH: FUTURES END #1, the fastest man alive is a broken man. His powers have failed him time and again at great cost to him and the city he has sworn to protect. Now he’s coming back to the current time to stop the one event that destroyed his life. And in the present, Barry Allen must contend with thieves trying to capitalize on the devastation of FOREVER EVIL. It’s a tale of two timelines that ushers in one of The New 52’s most anticipated character debuts!

In these tales from THE FLASH #36-40 and SECRET ORIGINS #7, The Flash is trapped in a bizarre lost land terrorized by castaways from the past, present, and future—and that leaves Central City without a hero! Even worse, a murderous, new Flash shows up to take Barry’s place! Will the Fastest Man Alive make it back in time to put things right?

Note: The volume is abbreviated in this issue.

Just when Barry Allen’s life was starting to return to normal, one of his most powerful and dangerous foes returns! Professor Zoom and his team of acolytes have broken Barry’s father out of prison, and now Barry must stop them before his life, reputation, and family are torn apart. Collects THE FLASH #41-47 and the Sneak Peek story from CONVERGENCE: DETECTIVE COMICS #2.

In the aftermath of his recent clash with Zoom from issues #48-52, The Flash is on the run from the law! And the task force charged with arresting him is made up of the Rogues! With villains like Captain Cold, Weather Wizard, and Mirror Master nipping at his heels, the Scarlet Speedster must clear his name while a new enemy emerges: the Riddler!

It’s probably a bad sign when Hercules comes asking for a favor. It’s juuuuuust a little job that needs doing, but this is Hercules; isn’t he supposed to be REALLY good at doing labors himself? Before they know it, Iron Man, Spider-Man and the are stuck looking after Orthus and Cerberus, the two legendary hounds of the underworld! Luckily, the dogs learn to behave after chewing up only a few cars, a statue, and Iron Man, and finally they’re obedient enough for the Metro Dog Show! Only problem, Hercules wants the dogs back. Oh no, Herc, not before the Hulk gets his ribbon! It’s two dogs with five heads between them, and all the action you can handle.

Three superheroes on their day off? A certain god says otherwise! Hercules needs their superpowers to watch his dogs while he's away. Seems like a simple task.. until Cerberus and Orthus, legendary guardians of the underworld, burst through a wall. While Spider-Man and Iron-Man desperately want to refuse, Hulk loves dogs, and Hercules won't take no for an answer. Two over-sized canines make for one big, messy adventure through New York (and its drool-ridden rubble), with a surprisingly minuscule end.

'ANT-MAN is On The JOB!!'-Well, he's LOOKING for a job, anyway...But his employment is put on hold when the insidious SANDMAN crosses his path-and ANT-MAN needs to pull out all the stops to defeat the Granular Goon! And, as ANT-MAN's popularity rises, so too do the suspicions of Vernon Van Dyne...!

Thunder gods! Lying gods! Father gods! Giant nasty monster dudes bigger than skyscrapers! Join comic legend LOUISE 'WEEZY' SIMONSON as she presents another epic tale featuring THOR, god of thunder!!!!

issue_title: Web Of Deceit; If This Be P.R.O.D.O.K.
description: Featuring CAPTAIN AMERICA, the Sentinel of Liberty, in the then & now! In the Now, he faces the hyper-technological might of Hydra! In the then, he battles the disgusting (and frankly, ugly) menace of P.R.O.D.O.K.!

Bulldogs are about the best dogs in the world. Everyone knows that. But when the Leader decides to use a robotic bulldog to steal all of SHIELD's private files, it's up to She-Hulk, Spider-Man and Tigra to clean up after the dog!

All Hawkeye wanted was to show the Blonde Phantom a new exhibit at the art gallery, but the art gallery is in a bank lobby, and on this day the bank lobby is featuring more than art; it has a gang of bank robbers! And they're not just any bank robbers...isn't that Bruce Banner with them? Or, hey, maybe it's not. If that's NOT Bruce Banner, then a little old fashioned detective work on the part of Hawkeye and the Blonde Phantom should put an end to the "Banner Bandit" crime spree. And if it IS Bruce Banner, well then...umm...let's just hope it's not.

Ahhh, the majesty of a Hollywood! The glamour! The glitz! Beautiful dresses! Well-tailored suits and a pair of… purple pants? When the Hulk and Tigra show up on the red carpet for Hollywood’s biggest awards night, a veritable shoo-in to win Best Documentary for the critically acclaimed “Don’t Look At The Camera: 3 days in the life of the Hulk,” it looks like it’s going to be a truly magical night… that is unless the supervillain known as Mysterio gets mad that HIS studio doesn’t win Best Special Effects and takes over the entire awards show in order to create an illusion that an alien armada is attacking New York, fooling the Hulk into thinking he’s defending the city when he’s really destroying it. But what are the chances of THAT happening. (Hint: It does.)

Spider-Woman, Beast and Giant Girl team up to play detective when Hercules is found unconscious after falling all the way from the moon. But what was the son of Zeus doing on the moon, and how did he manage to fall off? And how did Hercules’s day full of book-signings, pinball and origami lead him, and our trio of heroic detectives, into an all-out battle against Hydra for possession of the mysterious substance known as “delirium?”

A living legend. A divine warrior. An armored knight. A synthetic man. A cosmic woman. A spy. A rookie. Separately, they are some of the most powerful beings on the planet, but when a great tragedy brings these seven together, they will become far more than individuals, they will become something more. Join up-and-coming writer PAUL TOBIN and artist IG GUARA ( LOCKJAW & THE PET AVENGERS) for this newest launch in the revamped Marvel Adventures line!

The Avengers assemble with two new team members, one a cocky rookie with cosmic powers, and another the world's most talented secret agent. But will even the combined powers of the Mighty Avengers be a match for the ghost of an old world giant that's been terrorizing Britain? It's a new Avengers versus the Old World, with the life of an entire village at stake!

The Avengers have barely moved into their new mansion before they have their first visitor, the super villain known as the Plant Man. But Plant Man isn’t crashing the party, he’s asking for help in his battle against a violently berserk Silver Surfer, an interstellar powerhouse intent on planting the Plant Man. How much will the Avengers put on the line to protect a super villain, and can even the assembled Avengers stand against the Power Cosmic?

Iron Man, Hulk and Spidey rocket into space to stop a potentially devastating meteor shower from reaching Earth, but are surprised to find the meteors are actually Meteor Men, a group of intergalactic frat boys engaging in their most awesomely favorite extreme sport: Planet-Bombing. After negotiations (Could the Hulk quit hitting us, please?) the Meteor Men agree not to bombard Earth IF the heroes show them an equally good time on a variety of other planets, and other extreme sports. Will our heroes survive Albernathean Rhino Riding? How about Kree Karaoke? Or the galaxy’s most dangerous extreme sport, Black Hole Bungee Jumping?

Diablo is back, and as an alchemist who can control earth, air, fire and water, he’s one of the most deadly threats the Avengers have ever faced. But, who is controlling Diablo, and will the captive Iron Man learn the answer in time to save his life, and the lives of his teammates?

FINAL ISSUE! Who remembers Gary Gaunt? Considered a monster during World War II, he was secretly dropped behind German lines so his terrible “Jekyll and Hyde” transformations would disrupt the German war effort. Gaunt…forgotten by society, has been able to control his hideous transformations for over 60 years…but when his special serum is stolen, Nova and the Avengers find themselves at ground zero with the strangest man/ monster of them all!

The Iron Man of the future comes back in time to help our heroes fight Kang the Conqueror, who rules the future via a vast fortune acquired though his potato chip company. Yeah – potato chips. But these aren’t just run-of-the-mill potato chips, these are nano-temporal-potato chips…engineered so that if you ever eat one, the timestream forces you to eat them again for every single meal, forever. It's Iron Man, Spider-Man and the Hulk against an army of past and future warriors, and a bag of potato chips to boot! This an issue you don't want to miss.

KLAW'S GOOD OL' COUNTRY REVIVAL: When Klaw, the master of sound, forms a country and western band, Iron Man, Spider-Man and the Hulk decide to investigate. Unfortunately, the Hulk gets hooked on Klaw's mournful music and, wanting to solve those cliché-ridden problems Klaw so beauuutifully sings about, starts returning every lost (and not so lost) dog to its owner, insists on driving a pickup truck, and goes in for some very extreme "Hulk-style" relationship counseling. While this draws a lot of media attention to Klaw's band, it's the Hulk (dang it!) getting all the press, making an irritated Klaw VERY jealous. The fight is ON!

In his MA: Super Heroes debut, Doctor Strange encounters a cosmically powered creature known as a Zakimiya, which has been allowing its newborn babies to feed on the very fabric of reality. Dang! Luckily, Doctor Strange has a plan---recruit a magically souped-up Spider-Man to web shut the holes in the fabric of reality, and then hope the two of them can bluff their way to victory against the all-powerful Zakimiya. Good luck with that!

Here he comes, True Believers -- the astonishing ANT-MAN! The man with two, count 'em, TWO super powers! Who is he? How did he get both the ability to shrink to less than an inch tall and speak directly to ants? Why does he use those abilities to aid all mankind? SHUT UP -- Don't answer that! Those are rhetorical questions! Any answers you come up with can't possibly be as awesome as the real ones ... SO BUY THIS COMIC NOW!!!

Join legendary scribe LOUISE SIMONSON as she documents the origins of the greatest warrior godhood has e'er known: THE MIGHTY THOR! See how the God of Thunder came to our world, and what awesome adversities shaped him into a champion of man!

In the 1940s, Scrawny teen STEVE ROGERS volunteered for a government experiment that turned his body into the peak of physical perfection…CAPTAIN AMERICA! Cap busted heads during World War II, but then mysteriously disappeared…only to be found decades later, still young and ready to whup up on some bad guys! We’re proud to bring you TWO TALES for the price of one: A present-day story as Cap battles modern malevolence, and a flashback fable featuring Cap in the 40s!

A PENNY SHORT IS A DAY SAVED: In a time long gone, the Ancient One fought a tremendous battle against the Dread Dormammu, ultimately banishing the ruler of the Dark Dimension back to his own reality by power of a mystically binding contract. Unfortunately for Dr. Strange, that mystical contract is hundreds of pages long, and the Dread One has now found himself one nasty lawyer, and a whole lot of loopholes. Dr. Strange is going to need all the mystical might he possesses, along with the legal prowess of one Mr. Foggy Nelson, Attorney At Law, in order to send Dormammu packing, or maybe just to stay alive!
